pr.title: fix(server): keep sensitive values out of settings reads, startup logs and preview snapshots
pr.body: Three related changes that keep sensitive values out of settings responses, logs and preview snapshots. ## What changed **Settings reads (OpenCode server password)** - `serverPassword` in the OpenCode provider settings is now annotated with `secretSetting`. It is kept in the secret store instead of `settings.json`; an existing plain-text value moves there on the next load. - `server.getSettings`, `server.updateSettings`, the server config snapshot and `settingsUpdated` events return the redaction marker instead of the password. Saving other settings keeps the stored password. - `isSecretSetting` treats any `control: "password"` form field as a secret, so a future masked field that misses the annotation is not stored or returned in plain text. - Provider and source control settings forms show a clear button next to a saved secret field. - The Antigravity user guide no longer says the API key is stored in plain text. **Startup logs (web-mode pairing URL)** - The pairing URL, which carries a one-time admin token, is printed directly to stdout instead of being attached to a log record. Only a token-free "Authentication required" message goes through the logger, so the token no longer reaches the server trace file or OTLP log export. - The browser auto-open for that URL runs with `Effect.withTracerEnabled(false)`, so a failed launch no longer records the URL in span errors. The fallback hint points at the URL printed above instead of repeating it. **Preview snapshots (password fields)** - `preview_snapshot` reads the values of password fields, and text fields that CSS draws as dots, from an isolated world in each frame over CDP, before and after building the accessibility tree. - Those values are masked wherever the tree prints them (names, field values, quoted or not) and in `visibleText`. Roles, Playwright attributes and refs are unchanged. - The capture fails rather than returning a tree it cannot vouch for (a value changed between reads, a frame appeared or disappeared, or a frame was missed), and finishes within 10s including one retry. ## Behavior changes - The OpenCode server password field shows the "stored secret" placeholder once saved, like the Antigravity API key. After a downgrade, an older server would read the stored redaction marker as the literal password until it is re-entered. - The `pairingUrl:` stdout line keeps its text and indent, but is no longer bold on a TTY and now prints at every log level (it was previously dropped at `Warn`/`Error`). - Snapshots of pages with password fields can fail with a "too busy" or timeout message where they previously returned a tree, for example when a cross-process frame is busy for more than 1s. A frame that never loads now holds the tree for 8s instead of 15s. - In desktop tabs, cross-site frames are read in the page's own world, so a script there that redefines `value` can still keep a value out of the mask. ## Testing Ran locally on the combined branch (full suite left to CI): - Typecheck (`tsc-rs --noEmit`) for `apps/server`, `apps/web`, `packages/contracts` and `packages/provider-opencode`: all pass. - `apps/server`: `serverSettings.test.ts`, `serverLogger.test.ts`, `preview/ServerBrowserPage.test.ts`, `preview/ServerBrowser.test.ts`: 4 files, 125 tests passed. - `apps/web`: `components/settings/ProviderSettingsForm.test.ts`: 13 tests passed. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ---
